protocol.status: Local exploratory protocol, written before current corpus counts; not preregistered. Prior published negative interpretations and 2016 concordance examples are known.
protocol.aim: Audit two externally located anchors: f1r marginal alphabets and f116v mixed-script line. No learned key, phonetic claim, or translation.

f1r.source: Lisa Fagin Davis, 2024-09-08, screenshot-696.png preliminary table
f1r.mapping_policy: Retain 13 provisionally legible glyph groups; omit question-mark glyph rows. Add y from row with ambiguous j/k Latin alignment. Four globally fixed keys: left j or k; right ch=j or k. No optimization.
f1r.tokenization: Greedy cth ckh cph cfh ch sh in, then single EVA characters; missing values remain explicit. EVA is not phonetic.
f1r.outcomes: Coverage of clean word occurrences and vocabulary; complete prose lines; mechanical output with unknown glyph markers. No linguistic acceptance score. Coverage cannot validate or refute the omitted table rows or all cipher families.

f116v.exclude_target: All f116v rows excluded from recurrence counts; IT has no f116v entry.
f116v.primary: Exact clean tokens in a line; uncertain chunks are barriers; drawings are barriers.
f116v.sensitivity: First bracket reading, ordinary alphabetical ligatures, comma split or joined; hard barriers preserved. Also inspect adjacency across consecutive prose lines of the same paragraph.
f116v.interpretation: Two words in different scripts side by side are not necessarily equivalent translations. No known plaintext assigned.
